course_name_original: KI in der Produktion und Logistik

learning_outcomes.text: Define and describe the goals of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Operations Research (OR) with regard to software-based intelligent decision systems, with a special focus on production and logistics.
Name the difference between artificial intelligence, operations research, and machine learning.
Compare different approaches of artificial intelligence with their advantages and disadvantages.
Explain possible applications of artificial intelligence in typical areas of production and logistics.
Interpret data from the production and logistics environment and prepare it for processing by AI algorithms.
Apply selected AI and analytics technologies in the context of production and logistics.

syllabus_topics: Overview of typical problems and technologies of artificial intelligence with a focus on production and logistics applications
Learning methods: Decision Trees, Linear / Logistic Regression, Neural Networks
Optimization methods: Constraint Programming, Linear Optimization
Modern Software Frameworks and Solvers: MiniZinc, Google OR-Tools, Gecode, Chuffed, COIN CBC, LocalSolver
Integration of machine learning and predictions into decision making
Practical application of machine learning methods and optimization models for analysis and decision support in production and logistics systems
assessment_rules: The assessment is an oral exam (15 minutes). Bonus points can be earned from tasks and quizzes during the lectures, which can improve the final grade for the exam by a maximum of 10%.
